unresolved.what: Niger before 1964-07-17 (16 colonial cercles, 31 circonscriptions from 1961-12-31)
unresolved.why: First level 1960-08-03 → 1964-07-17 = the 16 colonial cercles (Agadez, Birni N'Konni, Dogondoutchi, Dosso, Filingué, Gouré, Madaoua, Magaria, Maradi, N'Guigmi, Niamey, Tahoua, Téra, Tessaoua, Tillabéry, Zinder), kept de facto above the 31 circonscriptions of law 61-50 (1961-12-31). The 1964 arrondissements «corresponded to the former circonscriptions», so each cercle is a union of 1964 arrondissements and hence of geoBoundaries NER ADM2 2018 departments (63 departments of 2011 + 4 city departments, all carved inside a 2001 department) — but no source found lists which circonscriptions formed each cercle (only that Dogondoutchi, Filingué, N'Guigmi and Téra had one each), e.g. whether Diffa and Maïné-Soroa lay in Gouré or N'Guigmi cercle.
